'''Poncho''' (Japanese: '''パンチョ''' ''Poncho'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG067|Go Go Ludicolo!]]''. He and his {{p|Ludicolo}} are traveling street performers who go from town to town with his {{p|Ludicolo}} to entertain people with their bongo-playing and dancing.

Poncho encountered {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} in the middle of a forest located near [[North Petalburg]]. He challenged Ash to a {{pkmn|battle}}, adding that if he wins, he gets their sandwiches, but if he loses, he would buy them some cheeseburgers. Ash accepted the challenge, choosing {{AP|Corphish}}. Poncho played his drums throughout the match, helping Ludicolo keep tempo and evade oncoming attacks with ease. As a result of that and Ash's underestimation, he lost.

Corphish refused to accept its defeat, and after searching for them, it found Poncho and Ludicolo and demanded a [[rematch]]. Before Poncho could respond, {{TRT}} captured him and Ludicolo. Corphish intervened, causing the trio's Meowth balloon to crash and send them blasting off. Impressed with how strong Corphish was, Poncho decided to share the sandwiches he received earlier with the group. Poncho also agreed to the rematch, this time against [[Ash's Torkoal]], though the winner was not revealed.
